name: Kazakhstan
exam_name: Тестирование по определению объема знаний государственного языка на элементарном уровне, основ Конституции Республики Казахстан, а также истории Казахстана
administering_agency: Национальный центр тестирования (Ministry of Science and Higher Education)

format.notes: Three blocks: Kazakh language 30 (15 listening, 15 reading), basics of the Constitution 40, history of Kazakhstan 30. One right answer of four, one point each. At least 50 points overall, with a minimum in each block. 30 extra minutes for people with a disability.

exemptions.age: The rules do not apply to minors.
exemptions.disability: The rules do not apply to people without legal capacity; people with a disability get 30 extra minutes.

unverified.fee: A payment receipt is required to register; the amount is not in the rules.
unverified.languages: Reported by a search summary of the same rules: the language block in Kazakh, the other two in Kazakh or Russian. The sentence itself was not read.

recent_change.summary: New rules for the test were approved by the Minister of Science and Higher Education (registered as V2600037844); the scope of knowledge was set by an order of 8 October 2024. The test requirement itself is recent.
